name: Sakaar Outpost: MCU Space Colony
description: Build and manage a thriving space colony on the dystopian scrap world of Sakaar with MCU heroes, villains, character-specific UI motifs (such as Iron Man's Arc Reactor & Tobey Maguire's Earth-96283 Raimi Spider-Man), movie canon dossiers, live search-grounded intel, and the Avengers: Doomsday Clock.
